pages: Day 111: He came back at dawn. He did not ask what had happened in the night. He already knew. He looked at the street, at the ones still breathing in it, and He did not look away, and I understood that He had decided before He ever left.
I write these lines with shaking hands and a cold grip around my heart. His decision stands, and although every part of me resists... I swore my obedience.
